## Hands-on 3 – Reproducing a recorded result {#hands-on-3-reproduce-the-recorded-result .smaller}

::: {.small}
- **Task 3**, in the webR workspace or in the working script of the IDE workspace: choose **C6HJR**, **KQXUE** or **018OL**
- In the webR workspace each analyst has a few cells of its own, one step to a cell, with gaps to fill, hints and full solutions; in the working script the three are written out
- In the browser, one cell of 018OL installs two packages for mixed models, a download of about 32 MB
:::

::: {.fragment}
When you have your value, compare it with the value on record.
:::

::: notes
Now you work. Open Task 3, in the webR workspace or, if you work in the IDE workspace, in the working script, and choose one of the three analysts. In the webR workspace each has a few cells of its own, one step to a cell, and every gap to fill has a hint and a fully worked solution underneath. Using the hints and the solutions is not cheating, because this task is about the number at the end rather than the typing. In the working script the three are written out, so read them line by line as you run them. If you choose 018OL in the browser, one of its cells downloads the packages for mixed models, so give it a minute. When you have your value, compare it with the value on record. If you finish early, take a second analyst. Twenty minutes.
:::
